# Ranatec AB
> Swedish manufacturer of RF test and measurement equipment — tunable filters, Butler matrices, digital attenuators, RF switch boxes, RF shield boxes and shielded feedthrough filters for wireless (5G, LTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) device and infrastructure testing.

Ranatec AB (Gothenburg, Sweden; founded 1991; part of the Qamcom Group; ISO 9001:2015 certified) designs, engineers and manufactures niche RF and microwave test equipment for design verification, product certification (3GPP/ETSI conformance), production testing, troubleshooting and in-service monitoring. Products are sold B2B by request for quote — no public prices. Customers include semiconductor, device and base-station manufacturers, ISPs, test houses and certification institutes. The site is published in three regional English versions with identical content: en-US (default), en-GB (/en-gb/) and en-CA (/en-ca/). Last updated 2026-10-06.

## Product domains
- Filtering: Digitally tunable band reject (notch) and band pass filters for 2G/3G/4G/5G, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth conformance and spurious-emission testing.
- Shielding: RF shield boxes (off-the-shelf and customised), forensic RF box, shielded feedthrough filters (USB, LAN, HDMI, AC, DC, optical fibre) and EMI ventilation panels.
- Switching: Solid-state switch modules and rack-mount RF switch boxes from DC to 26.5 GHz, plus a modular platform for custom switch systems.
- Automation: Digital step attenuators and attenuator boxes, Butler matrices and complete wireless test automation systems.

## Product categories
- [Tunable Band Reject Filters](https://ranatec.com/product-category/tunable-band-reject-filter/): Band reject filter with high resolution electronical tuning between 600-6000 MHz, for 2G/3G/4G/5G applications.
- [Tunable Band Pass Filters](https://ranatec.com/product-category/tunable-band-pass-filter/): Band pass filter with high resolution electronical tuning between 600-10 000 MHz.
- [Butler Matrices](https://ranatec.com/product-category/butler-matrices/): 4×4 and 8×8 Butler matrices with the widest operational bandwidth on the market, developed for frequencies from 2.4 to 8 GHz.
- [Digital Attenuator Boxes](https://ranatec.com/product-category/digital-step-attenuator/): Digital attenuator systems with attenuation range of more than 90 dB in steps of up to 0.25 dB.
- [Digital Step Attenuator Modules](https://ranatec.com/product-category/digital-step-attenuator-module/): Digital attenuator module with attenuation range of more than 90 dB in steps of up to 0.25 dB.
- [Switch Boxes and RF Test Automation Systems](https://ranatec.com/product-category/switch-box/): Flexible test system automation platform that helps you to integrate your complete test system into a single box.
- [Switch Modules](https://ranatec.com/product-category/rf-coaxial-switch/): RF and Microwave Solid State Switches with long lifetime, fast switching time, and low power consumption.
- [Shield Boxes](https://ranatec.com/product-category/rf-shield-box/): Off-the-shelf and customized RF shield boxes with various I/O interface configurations, ventilation, and rack mount option.
- [Forensic RF Shield Box](https://ranatec.com/product-category/forensic-box/): High performance Forensic RF box for analysis and protection of radio transceivers and transmitters.
- [Shielded Feedthrough Filters](https://ranatec.com/product-category/shielded-feedthrough-filters/): EMI/RFI shielded I/O interfaces with filter suppression over all mobile frequency bands.
- [EMI Ventilation Panels](https://ranatec.com/product-category/emi-ventilation-panels/): Enables ventilation of shielded boxes and rooms, while maintaining EMI/RFI shielding.

## Key facts
- Founded 1991; headquarters, engineering and manufacturing in Gothenburg, Sweden
- Part of the Qamcom Group (acquired by Qamcom Technology AB in 2018)
- ISO 9001:2015 certified
- All products designed, engineered and manufactured in Sweden; standard and customised products
- First-of-a-kind RI 268 tunable band reject filter 600–8000 MHz (combined 5 & 160 MHz) for 5G NR / Wi-Fi 7 conformance testing
- Widest-bandwidth 4×4 (RI 3041) and 8×8 (RI 3101) Butler matrices, 2.4–8 GHz
- Customer results: 5G test system delivered to a FAANG client (2020); 100 kEUR order for RI 266 filters (2021); signal-processing hardware for the SKAO radio telescope via Qamcom (2023)
